scripts.test:emulator: cd .. && npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,storage --project pet-underwriter-ai 'cd clovara-life && VITE_RUN_EMULATOR_TESTS=1 VITE_USE_EMULATORS=1 npx vitest run src/store src/analytics'
scripts.verify:migration: cd .. && npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project pet-underwriter-ai 'cd clovara-life && VITE_USE_EMULATORS=1 npx vite build >/dev/null && (npx vite preview --port 4174 --host 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3; node scripts/verify-migration.mjs'
scripts.verify:stripe: cd .. && npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions --project pet-underwriter-ai 'cd clovara-life && sleep 6 && node scripts/verify-stripe.mjs'
scripts.verify:sitter: cd .. && npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions --project pet-underwriter-ai 'cd clovara-life && sleep 6 && node scripts/verify-sitter.mjs'
scripts.verify:household: cd .. && npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions --project pet-underwriter-ai 'cd clovara-life && sleep 6 && node scripts/verify-household.mjs'
scripts.verify:photo: cd .. && npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,storage --project pet-underwriter-ai 'cd clovara-life && VITE_USE_EMULATORS=1 npx vite build >/dev/null && (npx vite preview --port 4174 --host 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; node scripts/verify-photo.mjs'
scripts.verify:all: npm run build && (npx vite preview --port 4173 --host 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && for s in verify-demo verify-onboarding verify-metrics verify-review verify-share verify-firstnight verify-passport verify-vaccines verify-toxins verify-attach verify-length verify-a11y verify-visitsummary verify-safety verify-companion verify-lumps verify-remember verify-c1c2 verify-briefing verify-senior verify-journey; do echo "— $s"; node scripts/$s.mjs || exit 1; done
